issues.description: install.sh version check still allows Python 3.7-3.9 despite minimum bump
issues.detail: The conditional `[ "$PYTHON_MINOR_VER" -lt "7" ]` was not updated to `-lt "10"`. The error message says 3.10 is required, but the script will still accept Python 3.7, 3.8, or 3.9 and proceed to install, then fail in confusing ways downstream when pip resolves against requires-python>=3.10.

issues.description: Stale `< 3.10 compatibility` comments and dead `default_raise` rationale remain after drop
issues.detail: Several comments still reference `< 3.10 compatibility` (e.g., `default_raise` docstring in `wallet_request_types.py` line ~42, and the comment block above `TransactionEndpointRequest`). With 3.9 removed these become misleading. Either remove `default_raise` if no longer needed or update the comments to reflect the real reason for `field(default_factory=default_raise)`.

issues.description: Amazon Linux/Rocky setup adds noisy `dnf search` and missing `--assumeyes` consistency
issues.detail: `dnf search python3.12` is a noisy no-op that prints results to logs but has no effect on the install. Also `dnf update -y` runs a full system upgrade just to install git+python, which is slow and can introduce unrelated package changes mid-CI. Prefer `dnf install -y git python3.12` (or `dnf makecache` if needed) and drop the search.

issues.description: Ruff `UP007/UP035/UP045` blanket-ignored, contradicting PR's stated goal
issues.detail: The PR description says Union/Optional should be migrated to `A | B` / `A | None`, but the diff disables exactly the Ruff rules (UP007 modern Optional, UP035 deprecated typing import, UP045 X|None) that would enforce this. Without a tracking issue link and a removal plan in the TODO, these ignores will silently become permanent.

issues.description: Dead `default_raise` helper may now be removable
issues.detail: `default_raise` was introduced specifically because pre-3.10 dataclasses couldn't express kw-only fields without defaults. Now that every dataclass uses `kw_only=True`, fields like `wallet_id: uint32 = field(default_factory=default_raise)` could be plain required kw-only fields. Worth a follow-up cleanup pass; not blocking.

issues.description: PowerShell `Install.ps1` doesn't error if only 3.9 is found
issues.detail: `$supportedPythonVersions` was trimmed to 3.10/3.11/3.12, but if a user has only Python 3.9 installed via `py`, the script will fall through without picking a version and may produce an unclear failure later. Consider emitting an explicit message that 3.10+ is now required, mirroring `install.sh`.

review.summary: The PR cleanly removes Python 3.9 plumbing from CI matrices, install scripts, dataclass version forks, and poetry lock entries. Main concerns: `install.sh` still allows >=3.7 in its version-check despite advertising 3.10, the CI now runs `dnf update -y` and a no-op `dnf search` on Amazon/Rocky, and `ruff.toml` ignores UP007/UP035/UP045 which directly contradicts the PR description's "use `A | B`" goal with no migration tracker. Several `< 3.10` comments and the `default_raise` shim are now stale and could be cleaned up.
